name: Boiled Eggs
steps: Bring a pan of water to a gentle boil.
Lower in the eggs with a spoon and start the timer.
Soft (runny yolk): 6-7 min. Medium (jammy): 8-9 min. Hard: 10-12 min.
Transfer to an ice-water bath for 2 min to stop cooking and ease peeling.
notes: Times are for large eggs from boiling. Medium eggs ~30 s less; extra-large ~1 min more. Starting from boiling (not cold) is more consistent.
